title: Back to basics: revisiting the role of erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein in hematology, laboratory medicine, and beyond.
snippet: The erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) and C-reactive protein (CRP) remain among the most widely used inflammatory biomarkers, yet their optimal use is not always well understood, potentially limiting their clinical utility and contributing to unnecessary investigations and costs.
